subject: Request: activation lead-time grace period & temporary multi-region RTO addendum
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@bluemesa.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@bluemesa.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting temporary adjustment to activation lead-time and RTO commitment

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. BlueMesa is on a tight rollout timeline for a new payments feature that must be active across two regions by Black Friday. Our internal ops runbook requires a maximum RTO of 2 hours for our payment-critical path during peak windows. I understand Redwood's standard multi-region activation lead-time is 4 hours for warm-standby; given our timeline we'd like to request a temporary SLA addendum that narrows the RTO to 2 hours and reduces the warm-standby activation lead-time to 1 hour for the US regions for the first 60 days post-launch.

We are prepared to accept a higher committed spend for reserved capacity and to enable additional monitoring hooks (trace sampling, token-level latency dashboards) if that helps make this feasible.

Would you be able to provide a short-term carveout (60–90 days) and an outline of operational requirements and cost uplift? Attaching a draft from our legal team for your reference.

Looking forward to a quick turnaround — launch freeze starts 2028-11-10.

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Platform Reliability
BlueMesa Payments

Attachments: BlueMesa_SLA_Addendum_Draft_20281024.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@bluemesa.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Oct 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting temporary adjustment to activation lead-time and RTO commitment

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and the draft. Quick summary from our side: we can consider a temporary, conditional exception for a reduced activation lead-time and improved RTO, but it requires three things up front:

1) A 90-day pilot period (we recommend 90 vs 60 to capture post-launch stabilization),
2) A minimum reserved capacity commit (we've sketched a pricing uplift in the attached draft), and
3) Observability and runbook changes (trace sampling at 10% for the payment path, token-level SLO alerts, and a dedicated on-call rotation with a 30-minute response SLA).

I've looped in Karthik and Naomi to scope the feasibility and to flag any product-side constraints (KV cache priming, cross-region prefix caching limits, and warm-standby activation automation). Can you confirm BlueMesa is comfortable with these operational requirements and the spend uplift? If yes, we'll prepare a formal addendum and expedite an internal approval path.

Next step: Karthik, can you validate whether the warm-standby orchestration can reliably achieve a 1-hour activation lead-time for the specified US region pair assuming the reserved capacity and pre-warmed KV caches? Naomi, please note the 10% trace sampling requirement.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Requesting temporary adjustment to activation lead-time and RTO commitment

Rishi / Elaine — I ran a quick feasibility check with infra and runtime teams. Summary:

- With a dedicated pre-warmed pool (reserved capacity) in both us-east-1 and us-west-2 and pre-populated KV caches for the payment prefixes, achieving a 1-hour activation window is operationally plausible but non-trivial. We need to ensure:
  * Cold-start paths are blocked for the payment prefix (no dynamic sharding during peak),
  * Cross-region replication of KV cache metadata is validated but is expected to be eventual; we will rely on prefix-level priming to avoid RPO exposure,
  * We must run a dry-run activation test (simulated failover) 48 hours before production roll and another during the first 72 hours post-launch.

- RTO of 2 hours for the critical payment path is achievable if the above conditions are met plus an elevated incident response commitment from BlueMesa (on-call contact within 15 minutes).

Operational caveats: not all model variants used in the payment path are currently available in the us-west-2 pool. If BlueMesa needs those variants, we either (A) provision additional model replicas ahead of time, or (B) provide a graceful fallback to compatible variants (with a documented impact matrix). That will change the uplift pricing.

I'll prepare an annotated addendum outlining the constraints, required acceptance tests, and the uplift buckets. Rishi — once BlueMesa confirms the acceptance tests and the uplift bracket, we can route for product approval.

Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 25 Oct 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting temporary adjustment to activation lead-time and RTO commitment

Elaine / team — following product and security reviews:

Decision: Approved (conditional, 90-day pilot). Key terms we are putting on the addendum:

- Pilot length: 90 days starting upon signed addendum and confirmation of pre-warmed capacity.
- Activation lead-time: 1 hour (US region pair) — subject to successful dry-run activation within 48 hours pre-launch.
- RTO: 2 hours for the payment-critical path during pilot scope.
- RPO: 30 minutes for payment-critical prefix, otherwise standard RPO applies.
- Required commitments from BlueMesa: 1) Reserved capacity minimum of 3x baseline for the pilot window, 2) Dedicated on-call contact (15-minute ACK), 3) Enable 10% trace sampling and token-level SLO routing.
- Observability: Redwood will provide a temporary dashboard link (30-day retention for pilot metrics) and a shared PagerDuty escalation policy.
- Pricing: a tiered uplift model (15–30% depending on replica set requirements); exact bracket will be finalized once BlueMesa confirms required model variants and fixture count.

Please confirm acceptance of these conditions and indicate the required model variants and the date you'd like to run the first dry-run activation. If accepted, I'll attach the signed addendum template and route to legal and contract for a fast-track signature (we can target a 48–72 hour turnaround post-approval).

Thanks — Naomi
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
